prompts.background: Use case photorealistic-natural. ONE high-resolution photographic landscape, wide 3:2 canvas matching a 1920x1248 desktop scene composition. Calm first-person human eye level, fixed natural 35mm lens, level horizon. Soft natural illumination, realistic texture, moderate contrast and saturation, no HDR, no fantasy glow. A continuous believable space with a clearly visible route from bottom center toward a stopping place near x=50%, y=48%. This is a BACKGROUND PLATE for later multi-plane FFmpeg camera parallax: keep the central view open, do not include large close framing objects at the edges since these are separate layers. The image must fill every edge with scenery. No people, bodies, animals, signs, buildings, text, logos, watermarks, collage or panels. A SMALL calm natural POND, clearly enclosed by a nearby opposite bank, muted jade-green water with subtle reflections and a few distant water lilies, soft vegetation around the banks and willow-like foliage at mid distance. Soft diffuse morning light from upper LEFT. Human-eye-level camera on a LEVEL DRY SHORE PATH leading from bottom center toward a place to stop ON THE BANK beside the water. Water begins beyond the path, not a lake ocean or flowing river. No large close reeds: they will be a transparent foreground layer.
prompts.middle: Use case photorealistic-natural compositing. Reference image 1 is ONLY the lighting, texture, palette and eye-level perspective reference. Generate ONE independent middle-near parallax layer on a genuinely TRANSPARENT RGBA background. Full wide 3:2 landscape canvas aligned with reference. Draw ONLY two sparse clusters of real pond REEDS with a few narrow leaves and one or two soft brown reed heads, at the lower outer LEFT 16% and outer RIGHT 18% of canvas. Plants grow from beyond bottom edge, reach up the side edges to 48% image height, not into center. Center and upper center transparent, no water or ground. Match the reference with soft sunlight from upper LEFT, natural material detail and moderate contrast. Preserve CENTRAL 60% of width as completely transparent from top to bottom for an open pathway. No backdrop, no ground plane, no solid-color background, no fake checkerboard, no vignette; every pixel except actual objects is transparent. No people, animals, text, logo, watermark or collage. One cutout plate ready to composite over the reference, not a rendering of a finished combined scene.
prompts.near: Use case photorealistic-natural compositing. Reference image 1 is ONLY a lighting, color and photographic texture reference. Generate ONE closest foreground layer with actual RGBA alpha transparency, wide 3:2 full canvas. Draw ONLY a few close broad green wetland leaves and low fern fronds emerging from beyond the bottom outer corners. Only bottom 23% and outer 17% on each side, natural subtle depth-of-field softness. No water plane, rocks, reeds across the center or floating unattached objects. Lighting matches reference: warm soft morning light from upper LEFT and natural gentle shadows. Everything above the lower corner foliage and the central 60% corridor must be completely transparent, not a blurry backdrop. Fine natural edges, no ground plane, no filled background, no solid color, no painted checkerboard, no vignette, no whole scene, no collage. No person, animal, text or watermark. Match the realism of the reference and keep the near plants modest so that they will slide outward as the viewpoint moves forward.
